scope: M2.5-A: session-start agent rules and the one-screen markdown brief content item
M2.5-B: optional .archmeld/SESSION.md card with snapshot/commit/counts and status freshness
M2.5-C: read-only AOCI-CODE cognition-map interop in archmeld_brief
M2.5-D: three-pair adherence experiment without a call sheet
not_included: E: evidence-bound cognition map (eligible after D, not started)

implementation.mcp: crates/archmeld-api/src/mcp.rs appends render_markdown as a second text content item for archmeld_brief; JSON stays first
implementation.cognition: crates/archmeld-core/src/cognition.rs reads aoci.txt and the declared code Volume; it never writes the map and never treats an Entry as a parsed relation
implementation.brief: crates/archmeld-core/src/brief.rs adds a cognition block only when a map is present; session_card_path/write_session_card/session_card_status implement the optional card
implementation.cli: archmeld brief --write [--out PATH] [--force] writes the card; archmeld status reports session_card.present/marker/snapshot_match/stale
implementation.exclusions: the default snapshot and drift walkers skip .archmeld/ so a generated card does not make the workspace stale

cases: user file is not overwritten without --force
the card itself does not make the workspace stale

mcp_stdio.case: spawns the real archmeld-mcp process and asserts two content items for archmeld_brief

cli_end_to_end.result: brief --write created .archmeld/SESSION.md; status reported session_card.present=true, snapshot_match=true, stale=false on a clean tree and stale=true after a source edit

adherence_experiment.protocol: same model, same task, same real archmeld-mcp shim; no call sheet; 3 runs per condition

success_line.correctness: 6/6 runs reported the five real callers and the dynamic unknown; no run claimed a confirmed call edge

adherence_experiment.finding: Python cross-module same-name binding: from pricing import apply_discount is attributed to legacy.apply_discount (a homonym), so impact on pricing.apply_discount returns only list_price. 5/6 runs detected it. Recorded in docs/REMAINING_BLOCKERS.md as a product gap; not counted as an agent error.

boundaries.mcp_surface: 8 read-only tools; no approve/apply/write tool added

limitations: AOCI-CODE is at v0.2.0-rc4; the parser targets the documented Volumes v1 / object-fras-v2 text and tolerates malformed lines as warnings
archmeld_status exposes session_card but not cognition_map; only brief exposes the AOCI block
the AOCI R relations are not resolved to ARCHMELD entities
the adherence experiment is n=3 per arm and one model; it is directional, not a general benchmark
both arms were told ARCHMELD was available, so this is not a no-tool baseline; status-before-edit is 3/3 in both arms
one B run took 2,082,769 ms (an outlier); the median B duration is 405,483 ms
E is eligible but has no design, implementation or acceptance
